scope: four outputs/*_Appearance.blend plus associated provenance metadata only
other_source_export: copy original to this private directory; one exclusive single-thread factory background Blender per source with autoexec disabled; deterministic largest raw mesh
evaluated_geometry: export raw and evaluated; require exact equality and no active modifiers for stable raw source topology, otherwise record and choose after inspection before sampling
source_grouping: exact mesh/topology summaries, scale/rigid/mirror normalized comparisons and source records; unresolved provenance joins conservative same group
freeze_order: candidate patch selection rule/order and generation rules
